rule: Code may not create semantic world entities; missing semantics must return to LLM repair.
year must be integer between 1230 and 1250.
G1-G4 chain must be valid or marked as party-created by LLM with cause.
Start attributes/skills must obey documented balance and biographical basis.
Significant item must have place/status/owner/holder/access/risk or be removed.
character map knowledge must not equal factual hidden graph by default.
Tension/deferred event requires cause, trigger/time, result, and visible manifestation.
Prose writer must not receive hidden motives/items/future dates/raw JSON.
Party start writes must be one transaction or rollback on failure.
Draft/needs_review source may be used only with status preserved and audit note.
